description: This is a Python source file implementing a conversational AI bot with functions for weather info, conversation saving/loading, and integration with various speech and language services. It sets up a pipeline for handling WebRTC or websocket transports, speech-to-text, language modeling, and text-to-speech, with event handlers for client connection management.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data based on format and invokes callback with results.

methods.name: get_saved_conversation_filenames
methods.description: Retrieves list of saved conversation filenames matching pattern.

methods.name: save_conversation
methods.description: Saves current conversation messages to a timestamped JSON file.

methods.name: load_conversation
methods.description: Loads conversation messages from a specified filename.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the conversational pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts the pipeline.
